stories.title: Trade and Iran war are on the agenda for Trump's state visit to China
stories.summary: President Trump meets with China's President Xi Jinping in Beijing with a trade truce and the Iran war on the agenda.

stories.title: Supreme Court extends access to mifepristone via telemedicine
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang asks abortion historian Mary Ziegler what a Supreme Court ruling on mifepristone access means for patients nationwide — even in states without restrictive abortion laws.

stories.title: Oilfield theft in Texas grows more organized — and more dangerous
stories.summary: The state of Texas is working to crack down on the growing problem of oilfield theft. Estimated losses from stolen crude across the state total a billion dollars.

stories.title: Cape Verde: Tiny nation, massive World Cup dream
stories.summary: In Cape Verde, a small island nation off West Africa, World Cup qualification is transforming dreams on and off the pitch for young soccer players.

stories.title: Growing number of homeless people caught up in NYC crackdown on sleeping on subways
stories.summary: A growing number of homeless New Yorkers are finding themselves in court after police caught them taking up more than one seat on public transit or lying on the floor of a station in recent months.

stories.title: 18 passengers return to U.S. after weeks on cruise ship hit with hantavirus outbreak
stories.summary: Eighteen U.S. passengers have returned stateside after weeks on the cruise ship at the center of a hantavirus outbreak. They're being monitored at specialized medical facilities.
